about: The upstream releases the Upstream workflow watches (tools/upstream/README.md). `version` is the release hidane was verified against: for a `verified` package the one in crates/hidane/src/project/verified.rs, for the others the one last reviewed. `emulator` is the official emulator the fixtures were recorded from (.github/actions/official-emulator/pinned.sh) and the Emulator UI verified with it. `python3 tools/upstream/watch.py check` keeps them in step.
